title: Evidence record
description: Evidence record (Novera Protocol Specification v0.1, pre-production). Evidence is referenceable independently of the state it supports. Novera MAY hold only a content hash and a reference rather than the underlying document. The existence of an evidence record does not imply that the evidence is authentic, legally sufficient or valid; authoritative confirmation may still be required.

version.description: Record version. Status changes create new versions; the contentHash of a version never changes.

evidenceType.description: Kind of evidence. Core values are listed; namespaced extension values are permitted.

title.description: Short, non-identifying title for the evidence. MUST NOT contain personal data.

subjectRefs.description: Records this evidence relates to. Evidence MAY relate to several records, for example a participant and a workflow.

source.description: Name or role of the system or party from which the evidence was obtained.

sourceType.description: Kind of source: issuer_direct (delivered by the issuer), authoritative_registry (obtained from an authoritative registry), participant_upload, professional (provided by a professional acting in the workflow), adapter_observation (produced by an adapter), system_generated.

contentHash.description: Digest of the exact bytes of the evidence content. Consumers MUST verify retrieved content against this digest before relying on it.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the content, for example application/pdf.

storage.description: Where the content is held: hash_only (Novera holds only the digest; the content stays with the source), external_reference (content retrievable at uri under the source's access control), deployment_store (held by the deployment under its own access control).

uri.description: Locator for the content, when storage is external_reference or deployment_store. MUST NOT embed credentials, access tokens or personal data. Possessing the URI MUST NOT be sufficient to access confidential content.

observedAt.description: When Novera observed or received the evidence.

issuedAt.description: When the issuer issued the evidence, if stated.

validFrom.description: Start of validity stated by the issuer.

validUntil.description: End of validity stated by the issuer.

status.description: Status of the evidence in the workflow: received (recorded, not reviewed), under_review, accepted (accepted for its stated purpose by an authorized reviewer), rejected, superseded (replaced by newer evidence), expired, revoked (withdrawn by the issuer). accepted is not a statement of authenticity or legal sufficiency.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed.

review.description: Outcome of a review of the evidence for a stated purpose.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer. An assistive system MUST NOT be the reviewer of record.

purpose.description: Purpose for which the evidence was reviewed, for example real_estate.purchase.financing_condition.

handling.description: Data-handling classification of the content (not of this record).

classification.description: Confidentiality classification: public, internal, confidential or restricted.

containsPersonalData.description: Whether the content contains personal data. When true, the content MUST NOT be published and storage SHOULD be hash_only or external_reference.

retentionPolicy.description: Namespaced retention policy identifier applied by the deployment.
